marketing_wrapper: Medium. A navy-to-indigo gradient backdrop with a white SF caption and a modern iPhone frame holding about 65-70% real UI. 01 overlays an ADA 2026 winner laurel and award cube on the bottom third of the screen; 03 overlays an Editors' Choice quote on the widget view; 05 is the Apple Watch app on a rendered Ultra with an App of the Day laurel. 02, 04 and 06 show clean full screens.

typography.display: System SF Pro: semibold titles ('Total Solar Eclipse', 'Waning Gibbous'), bold day numbers in the lunar calendar.
typography.numerals: SF proportional semibold; times in white pill labels ('09:41 PM', '05:30 PM') with leading zero, which suggests a fixed-width time format; eclipse times in semibold ('7:36:34 PM'). Zodiac glyphs under calendar days.
typography.weights: Semibold labels and values, regular secondary in muted lavender-grey.
typography.case_and_tracking: Title and sentence case; no all-caps.

palette.accent_strategy: Near-monochrome, data-driven: everything is navy/indigo night with white and lavender-grey type; photoreal moon images carry the content, and the only warm colour is a copper-red moon marking a lunar eclipse day. White pills mark the current time and date on the scrubbable rails.
palette.source: palette.json 01 (#070f36 / #10194c / #18225e), 02 (#1e2773 / #25307d calendar), 04 (#010101 globe view, #2c2c2e sheet); lavender text and eclipse copper are visual estimates

shape.radius_language: pill and large: capsule buttons and time pills, grouped capsule toolbars, circular icon buttons, sheet about 30 pt top radius, grouped inset cards about 18 pt, widgets at system radius
shape.concentric: yes: the eclipse sheet's inset cards and segmented control follow the sheet and screen corners (matching WWDC26's 'concentric sheet edges')
shape.borders_shadows: Glass rims with a light edge on buttons; hairline separators in the calendar; no drop shadows.
shape.materials: Liquid Glass controls over a dark sky; photoreal moon renders; 3D globe map; AR camera view.

liquid_glass_visible: yes: grouped glass toolbar capsules top-right (telescope; layers plus ellipsis), circular glass compass and close buttons, a floating 3-icon glass tab bar (list, calendar, telescope) in 02, a glass segmented control and sheet in 04, glass chips over the AR view in 06
density: low on the main sky view; medium-high in the lunar calendar (7-column grid of moon images with day numbers and zodiac glyphs)
layout: Main: a dark sky stage with a compass button top-left and glass tool groups top-right; a horizontal 'Today' date rail and a vertical time rail with white pill labels at the edges; centre: the moon on a dotted orbit arc over a ground ellipse with a 3D direction pointer. Lunar Calendar: filter and settings glass buttons, location/month/time pills, then a weekly grid of moon-phase images. Eclipse: a 3D globe with the eclipse path and a glass sheet with Info/Times segments.
navigation: Floating glass tab capsule with 3 icon-only tabs; glass toolbar groups; sheets with drag handles; the main view scrubs time and date along edge rails.
imagery_and_icons: Photoreal moon photography per phase, a 3D globe, an AR camera feed, zodiac glyphs, SF Symbols in glass buttons (telescope, layers, compass, calendar).
signature_visual_move: The moon hangs on a dotted path in a dark navy sky, and time and date are scrubbed along white pill rails at the screen edges under glass controls.
tells_present: Purple, indigo, violet; purple-to-blue gradient (indigo night palette, motivated by the subject)

direction_fit.why: The palette is the night sky, content is real moon imagery positioned by data, and there is a scrubbable time axis; deep, idiomatic Liquid Glass sits on top, as Apple's citation says.

notes: This is the clearest Liquid Glass reference in the batch: grouped toolbar capsules, a floating icon tab bar, concentric sheet insets. The indigo palette would trip the purple/indigo tell in a lint, but here it is the subject (night sky), so the tell needs a 'motivated by content' exemption.
